topic: What one unit of alcohol actually looks like

hook.text: Is one glass of wine one unit? Usually not.

beats.text: In the UK, one unit is 10 millilitres of pure alcohol. That's a single 25 millilitre shot of spirits.
A standard 175 millilitre glass of wine is just over 2 units. A pint of strong lager is 3.
The NHS advises no more than 14 units a week, spread over 3 or more days.
In the US, a standard drink is bigger: 14 grams of alcohol, compared with 8 grams in a UK unit. Guidelines differ, so ask your doctor what's right for you.
One easy step: check the strength on the label before you pour.

cta: Save this, and talk to your doctor if you're worried about how much you drink.
